name: anvil-local
notes: Local anvil development chain. Everything it holds is a labeled mock: mock tokens, a mock aggregator and a mock VRF coordinator, none of which may appear in a testnet or mainnet manifest. anvil's native coin has no protocol-level name; it is labeled BNB here so that local runs model BSC. Multicall3 and the genesis hash stay null because nothing has been verified against a running node; a local deployment records its own addresses in its manifest, not here.
